requirements: The legacy runtime Git blob SHA remains unchanged.
Every source manifest and population-band record normalizes without loss or duplicate IDs.
All thirty-seven population bands generate deterministic normalized legacy records.
The random-population sentinel never appears as a generated record band.
Every class-pool mode, power tier, age option, ancestry option, and batch boundary is exercised.
The same seed and options reproduce byte-equivalent records and canonical profiles.
Every record contains exactly seventeen legacy rows in the original order.
Standard classes preserve numerical progression descriptors and custom classes preserve conversion-pending language.
Bands without crew roles use the exact legacy shore-based fallback.
Noncombatant readiness produces scan-clean presentation state.
Legacy rendered-card objects import without changing their row values.
Universal profiles preserve selected name, ancestry, age band, region, occupation, class, level, crew role, faction, characterization, source IDs, and compatibility-pack provenance.
The Kaysender compatibility layer does not modify kaysender-npc-generator.js.
